data.title: HRH the Crown Prince Congratulates Amir of Kuwait on Successful Medical Examinations
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, sent a cable of congratulations to Amir of the State of Kuwait Sheikh Meshal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah on his successful medical examinations.
    HRH the Crown Prince extended his heartfelt congratulations and best wishes to the amir, praying for his continued health and happiness.
    -- SPA
20:27 Local Time 17:27 GMT
